slices.focus: A lot has shifted lately, and work has gotten bigger in a way I did not exactly
slices.summary: After Denise's retirement, Monica absorbs corridor briefing duties under new leadership and pushes the scope from one protected pilot corridor to two-corridor repeat-call block comparisons; she navigates the vulnerability of being more visible while working to make the process less dependent on her alone.
open_loops: Protect standing briefing slot under new leadership
Assign comparison table data pull to team member
Document functions now owned for future leverage
decisions: Monica's corridor work expanded from one protected pilot corridor into a formal north-side enforcement priority tracking
